schema_note: Summary of the enforced research rules (Plan 6, phase P4). No price data. Describes tool behaviour and offline test evidence only.

rules.rule: A run with use: financial needs a pass report, or a pass-with-exceptions report with an owner-written acceptance covering every non-pass check; a fail report is never loadable.
enforced_at: scripts/analysis.py run (before any output is written)
rules.not_in_make_check: local data is absent in CI

rules.rule: A new (not imported) record that is not blocked and not attempt failed/abandoned needs refs.run_id and refs.run_manifest_sha256; the run must be use: financial with a passing or accepted quality status, re-verified at log time from the quality report and acceptance on disk (not from the gate fields in the manifest).
enforced_at: research/control/experiment_registry.py validate (shape, log time and make check)
scripts/experiments.py log (reads and hashes the manifest; re-runs verify_for_financial_use inside the data root)

rules.rule: A keep record is never imported, failed or abandoned. It needs a nautilus run that meets the same financial requirement as the candidate run and is bound to it (same datasets.manifest_sha256, same config strategy, market and instruments), a clean passing parity receipt with engine files unchanged between full-SHA commits, and a tracked validation receipt from a Validation skill that is not a researcher skill, with at least one passing check, covering both run ids and naming the same parity receipt.
enforced_at: scripts/experiments.py log (files, binding, engine identity by git, receipt tracked by git)
scripts/experiments.py check (tracked validation receipt incl. parity receipt id, no local files)

limits: Acceptance is bound to one report by SHA-256; it does not prove the owner understood the exceptions.
Parity receipts vouch for engine code (engine-file identity), not for the candidate.
Validation roles are self-reported; the tool enforces separation of recorded roles, not independence.
No CLI produces a candidate's nautilus run (parity runs are engineering runs and are rejected as the nautilus run), so no keep record can be logged in practice yet.
The registry is an append-only local file; a self-consistent hand-forged chain is outside what it can prevent.

real_data_observation.task: Task 1, financial run attempted on the real dataset to observe the refusal; nothing was written
real_data_observation.refusal: financial use needs an accepted quality report: uncovered checks ['zero_volume', 'cent_rounding', 'actions_converted', 'actions_excluded', 'cross_source', 'split_events'] (no acceptance.json in the report folder); the owner accepts with scripts/data.py accept

created_in_this_plan.statement: No acceptance, no registry record and no validation receipt were created in this plan; tests used temporary roots only and the 110 existing records are unchanged.
